name: @magpie-community/opencode-aiproxy-auth
description: AiProxy provider plugin for Magpie/OpenCode with native account, plan and wallet quota reporting

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check opencode.mjs && node --check opencode2.mjs

summary.en: Your own AiProxy site: API-key models over OpenAI Chat or Responses, console password or browser-cookie sign-in, and wallet and plan quota windows.
summary.zh: 接入自己的 AiProxy 站点：API key 调用 OpenAI Chat 或 Responses 模型，控制台密码或浏览器 Cookie 登录，显示钱包及套餐额度窗口。
